spans.s: शौष्कल (I) m. A vender of flesh.
शौष्कल (II) n. The price of dried meat.
सौशील्य n. Excellence of disposition, good morals.
सौष्ठव n. 1. Excellence, superior beauty, ननु स्वांगसैष्ठवातिशयमुभयोर्दृष्टवती भगवती Mal.i.; 2. extreme skilfulness, cleverness; 3. lightness, suppleness, fleetness.
सौस्नातिक m. One who asks whether an ablution has been auspicious, सौस्नातिको यस्य भवत्यगस्त्यः R.vi.61.
